notes:
[Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) synergize so well with Mercy's kit, so I feel I do her a disservice by not leaning into it with  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) 

Take [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) against [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power)

Take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) against  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power)

## **Playstyle:**
Play Mercy as usual. Watch your angles and keep your beam constantly active. Focus healing for easy cash and ult charge, but keep in mind to use your damage boost whenever your healing isn't needed. I aim for a 60%/40% split, personally, but so long as your team is alive and enabled by you you're set.

round_upgrades.notes: Hands down the absolute best first power for Mercy. Keep the beam juggled between your allies and you'll gain constant ult charge and cash, both extremely important for this build.

notes:
[Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) is my personal all-time favorite rare Support item, especially for high healing Supports like Mercy. 

## **$10,000**
Take [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f), [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054), and any other [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) or [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) Blue or Green items you want.

## **Under $10,000**
Sell your survival ability from Round 1 and try to buy as many recommended Blue items as you can, prioritizing [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). If you still cannot afford Blue items, buy as many [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and Survival Green items as you can.

## **Struggling to survive?**
If you find yourself getting gunned down by a [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) character such as  [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b),  [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), or [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), take [Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03) and/or [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) 

Meanwhile, if an [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) hero such as [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18) is the problem, go for [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) and/or [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214)

## **Playstyle:**
Adjust your playstyle according to whether you won or lost. 

If you won, keep going as you were last round. Just make sure you aren't getting over-confident and keep playing smart and safe.

If you lost or feel targeted, play corners and stay safe. If you're a flighty Mercy like I am, contemplate keeping grounded for now until you've got some confidence in being able to stay alive. Keep in mind that your beam stays attached through walls for a couple seconds, so don't be afraid to break LOS if you need a quick break.

notes:
## **$20,000**
For [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb): Buy [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448), and any Blue and Green items you can afford. Prioritize [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and  [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed).

For [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) take [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) and any Blue and Green items you can afford. Prioritize [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction).

## **Under $20,000**
Sell [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and try to catch up on any Blue items you may have missed before. [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed), and Survival are all things you cannot go wrong with.

## **Chain Evoker: Is it worth it?**
I personally prioritize heals over damage boost so I do not get much use out of this item, but if you are a blue beam mercy this could help you stack up that sweet, sweet ult charge just a little easier. It's not the best use of cash in my opinion, but I can imagine it having a purpose in the right hands. Now would be the time to grab it if you want it.

## **Playstyle:**
No matter what, keep playing smart and safe. You can't help your team if you're dead, so prioritize your safety so you can guarantee theirs.

If you took [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb), it's business as usual until you ult. Once you cast your ultimate, whip out that barbie blaster and become the wasp you were born to be. Use your Guardian Angel to keep yourself moving and focus your shots on low health targets. Keep watch on your positioning compared to your teams, it's easy to lock in too much and waste vital usage of your hands free Valkyrie because you lost LOS with your team.

If you took [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591), play the same as you would with Crepuscular Circle. But now, you can essentially have a 20s Valkyrie if you time your resurrections right. It won't always line up perfectly, but if you can wait to rez until your valk runs out, or wait to cast your ult until after Renaissance ends, you can be an annoying wasp for much longer.

## **Under $30,000**
Sell [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and buy as many of the items you've missed so far as you can.

## **Playstyle:**
Same as last round. Keep cruising and playing with your team. Always keep in mind that you can never 1v5, even if you feel like an unkillable beast.

## **$45,000**
Sell [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and buy [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) as well as as many of the Purple items mentioned above as you can.

## **Under $45,000**
Buy what you can. Prioritize Survival and [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) items.

## **Playstyle:**
Essentially the same as Round 3's notes. Play normal Mercy until you activate your ult, then play as an annoying wasp against the enemies. Watch your positioning and make sure to utilize your Guardian Angel often to make it harder to shoot you and keep you in LOS with your team.

Do your best to time your rez's to happen before or after you valk and vice versa to get those nice 20s Valk's, but don't sweat it if the timing doesn't work out. Just do your best to keep yourself and your team alive.

## **$55,000**
Sell [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) and buy  [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429).

## **Under $55,000**
Buy what you can from previous rounds. Prioritize Survival, [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) as is needed.

## **Survival??**
If you need to, swap out [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429) with one of these Purple Survival items. as you see fit. All are wonderful items with different purposes.
- [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98), you cannot go wrong with more [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and a constant influx of health. Take this if you need a little help regaining health fast.
- [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8), is a good general Survival item. Take this for just a little extra assurance against some of the more heavy hitting abilities in the game.
- [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d), if you are up against a sustained damage hero such as [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546) or [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed). 
- [Divine Intervention](item_b5148b7f-8529-4b1b-a90c-5d7cf13f8f0c), if you are up against a burst damage hero such as [Junkrat](hero_3ac20f6c-2bce-45f3-998e-9129cc6e5c05) or an [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18).

## **Playstyle:**
Same as before. The build is more or less set in stone now. Feel free to swap around items as is needed to go with how the game is running, and just remember to stay alive to keep your team alive.

Sell [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) and buy [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e). ## **Under $60,000**
I fear I'm gonna have to say what I've said every other round. Buy what you can and godspeed my friend.

## **Playstyle:**
You should be the true annoying wasp you came here to be. You've gotten your bag, but those pesky enemies are still fighting strong. Rez and Valk whenever you can, watch your angles, and as always, keep yourself alive to keep your team alive.

Good luck!!!!
